required_tables.commit: HIP graph bubbles: kernel count must match RUN_ARGS in rocprof-sys-hip-graph-bubbles-tests.cmake and _HIP_GRAPH_BUBBLES_* in test_hip_graph_bubbles.py; if those change, update min_rows, expected_result, and descriptions below.
required_tables.name: kernels

validation_queries.description: Kernel row count equals num_kernels * num_iterations from RUN_ARGS (64*6 here); change with RUN_ARGS and CMake/pytest.
validation_queries.error_message: Kernel count does not match 64 * 6 graph executions
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM kernels

validation_queries.error_message: Found kernels with null function names
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM kernels WHERE name IS NULL

validation_queries.description: No kernels with zero active time
validation_queries.error_message: Kernels with no active execution times found
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM kernels WHERE (end - start) = 0

required_tables.commit: HIP graph bubbles:  PMC rows present when ROCPROFSYS_ROCM_EVENTS is set (raw COUNT rocpd_pmc_event % COUNT kernels).
required_tables.name: rocpd_pmc_event

validation_queries.description: Total rocpd_pmc_event rows must be an exact multiple of kernel count.
validation_queries.error_message: rocpd_pmc_event count is not a multiple of kernel count
validation_queries.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rocpd_pmc_event) % (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kernels) AS count

validation_queries.error_message: NULL value found in rocpd_pmc_event id column
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM rocpd_pmc_event WHERE id IS NULL

validation_queries.error_message: NULL value found in rocpd_pmc_event event_id column
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM rocpd_pmc_event WHERE event_id IS NULL

validation_queries.error_message: NULL value found in rocpd_pmc_event pmc_id column
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM rocpd_pmc_event WHERE pmc_id IS NULL

required_tables.commit: HIP graph bubbles: graph_launch region count must match num_iterations RUN_ARG; keep in sync with CMake/pytest when RUN_ARGS change.
required_tables.name: regions

validation_queries.description: roctxRangePush(graph_launch) once per iteration (6 here); must match num_iterations RUN_ARG.
validation_queries.error_message: Expected 6 roctx marker regions for graph_launch
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM regions WHERE category = 'rocm_marker_api' AND name LIKE '%graph_launch%'

validation_queries.error_message: Found rocTX API captures where duration is 0
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM regions WHERE category = 'rocm_marker_api' AND duration = 0
